name: create_actix_items_endpoint
description: Creates an Actix-web in-memory /items REST endpoint (GET + POST)
prompts:
This Cargo project (Cargo.toml already lists actix-web, tokio, serde, and serde_json as dependencies) needs a src/main.rs. Using Actix-web, build an in-memory REST resource at /items with shared state (a Vec of items behind a Mutex, created once and shared across all Actix workers via web::Data) that supports:
- GET /items: returns 200 with a JSON array of every item created so far (each item is an object with a "name" string field), in insertion order.
- POST /items: accepts a JSON body {"name": "..."}, appends it to the in-memory list, and returns 201 Created with the created item as JSON.
Items must persist across requests within the same server run (do not reset state per-request). Have the server listen on 0.0.0.0:8040.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "items_endpoint"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
actix-web = "4"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

test_setup_files.test_items.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error, os

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8040{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        return e.code, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)

subprocess.run(['cargo', 'build', '--offline'], check=True)
srv = subprocess.Popen([os.path.join(os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'target'), 'debug', 'items_endpoint')])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/items')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8040'
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200 on initial GET /items, got {status}'
    assert body == [], f'expected empty list initially, got {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'widget'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201 Created, got {status}'
    assert body['name'] == 'widget', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/items')
    assert status == 200
    assert isinstance(body, list) and len(body) == 1, f'expected 1 item, got {body!r}'
    assert body[0]['name'] == 'widget'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'gadget'})
    assert status == 201

    status, body = req('GET', '/items')
    assert status == 200
    assert len(body) == 2, f'expected 2 items after second POST, got {body!r}'
    names = {it['name'] for it in body}
    assert names == {'widget', 'gadget'}, f'unexpected item set: {names!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
